description: This file defines the FileStorage class implementing configuration file storage in Drupal, including methods for reading, writing, deleting, renaming, and listing configuration files, as well as managing collections.

classes.name: Drupal\Core\Config\FileStorage
classes.description: Implements configuration file storage with methods for CRUD operations, collection management, and directory handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes FileStorage with directory and collection, sets up file cache.

methods.name: getFilePath
methods.description: Returns the full path to a configuration file based on its name.

methods.name: getFileExtension
methods.description: Returns the file extension used for configuration files, 'yml'.

methods.name: ensureStorage
methods.description: Checks and creates the storage directory and .htaccess if needed.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a configuration file exists.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads and decodes a configuration file, utilizing cache.

methods.name: readMultiple
methods.description: Reads multiple configuration files at once.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Encodes and writes data to a configuration file, updating cache.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a configuration file and removes it from cache.

methods.name: rename
methods.description: Renames a configuration file and updates cache.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes data into YAML format.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes YAML data into an array, returns FALSE if not an array.

methods.name: listAll
methods.description: Lists all configuration file names in the collection.

methods.name: deleteAll
methods.description: Deletes all configuration files with an optional prefix.

methods.name: createCollection
methods.description: Creates a new collection instance.

methods.name: getCollectionName
methods.description: Returns the current collection name.

methods.name: getAllCollectionNames
methods.description: Returns all collection names within the storage directory.

methods.name: getAllCollectionNamesHelper
methods.description: Recursively discovers collection names based on directory structure.

methods.name: getCollectionDirectory
methods.description: Returns the directory path for the current collection.

methods.name: getFileSystem
methods.description: Provides the file system service.
